name: Visual Error Level Anomaly (ELA)
description: An aggressive X-ray depot strictly hunting down digital grave-robbers. Whenever an image is blasted onto the internet, it suffers a brutal JPEG compression aging. When a fraudster downloads it, surgically amputates a dog’s head onto a human body, and resaves it as a JPEG down the road. Boom! That newly grafted head possesses a radically different 'compression age' (Error Level) than the ancient host body. ELA brightly incinerates that chronological discrepancy into plain daylight, leaving zero room for denial.
algorithm: JPEG Entropy Decay & Differential Compression Amplification
mechanism: The algorithm sneaks the suspect image, sadistically hyper-compresses it one additional time at a known Quality (e.g. 75%), and then violently SUBTRACTS the new image from the old one! Authentic native background elements are already deeply degraded, meaning they hardly change (displaying extremely low ELA error, appearing pitch black). However, the synthetic faces, text edits, or spliced objects freshly pasted by the fraudster yesterday haven’t suffered compression erosion yet.. maliciously triggering them to BLAZE PURE BLINDING WHITE, proving chronological de-synchronization.
parameters: Action Trigger: Superimposed Re-Compression, Degradation Core: Target JPEG Quality 75 Level, Tracker: Extreme Luminance Variance Amplification
accuracy: Visually Unrivaled (70-85%) - Viciously massacres sensationalist fake news, doctored bank transfer receipts, and clumsy text manipulations smeared hastily over digital canvases.
source: Krawetz (2007) - Hacker Factor Arsenal: Forensic Error Level Assessment
useCase: Deploys a devastating optical thermal-map directly to the observer, screaming in blazing white light exactly where the barbaric splicing occurred or where a bank account balance was fraudulently altered via text-forgery.

references.title: Krawetz, N. (2007). A picture's worth... digital image analysis and forensics. Black Hat.

strengths:
• Inconceivably visceral optical superiority: Even untrained civilian eyes can stare at the stark B&W ELA map, point a finger directly at the blazing forged zone, and laugh in the face of the fraudster.
• The absolute worst nightmare for financial fraudsters doctoring digital bank receipts; merely Photoshopping a new digit causes that fresh pixel-text to violently glow in ELA radiation due to un-eroded compression physics.
limitations:
• The executioner’s blade shatters harmlessly if hurled at Lossless compression formats (e.g., PNG), because the ELA radar is exclusively architected as a graveyard specifically for the JPEG compression family.
• The radar frequently spams absurd False Positives against natively sharp, high-contrast outlines (e.g., authentic hard logo text) because intense sharp edges naturally hemorrhage extreme JPEG compression light naturally, easily leading to wrongful convictions.
